summary: V31 multi-tenancy (engines/settings/rules) + Plan Matrix Editor: 28/28 pytest passing. Backend engines/settings/rules correctly isolated by owner_license_key; bayi toggle no longer bleeds to master. POST alternates /rules/{id}/delete, /rules/{id}/update, /settings/update work (Apache PUT/DELETE-safe). Plan Matrix Editor GET/POST/reset all wired; /api/plan/features reflects DB matrix; non-master gets 403. Frontend /panel/plan-config renders header, 3 feature groups (Kapasite/İleri Güvenlik/Ekosistem), 3-column plan table (Starter/Pro/Enterprise), int inputs, boolean toggles. Save button gated on dirty state, Reset triggers confirm dialog and shows Turkish success toast. Regression on 6 core endpoints + blacklist/check + analytics/plan-event + migrations idempotent — all green.

critical.issue: CRITICAL — Legacy dedupe (line 448-457) deleted every bayi engine row on each backend restart (dedupe used only `name`, not (name+owner_license_key)) AND recreated a single-field unique `name_1` index which then blocked bayi bootstrap with E11000 duplicate key errors. Migration fix_engines_index.py was defeated by this startup code. Fixed by T1: dropped legacy name_1, migrated legacy docs with owner_license_key='', dedupe composite key, recreate name_owner_unique composite unique index.

minor.issue: Master cannot create-on-behalf-of a bayi. _tenant_scope resolves scope from license_key_arg first, so passing ?license_key=WS-... flips scope to bayi even when x-master-key header is present. Fix: prioritize x-master-key header for is_master check, then use license_key as target owner. Comment at server.py:1288-1290 promises this behavior; docstring says 'Master bir bayi adına eklemek isterse ?license_key=WS-… göndersin' — currently non-functional.

action_items: Review the startup dedupe fix I applied in server.py (~line 445-475). Ensures multi-tenant safety on every backend restart. If you regenerate server.py, keep this fix.

Fix _tenant_scope precedence so master (x-master-key header or gws_master_session cookie) can target another bayi via ?license_key=WS-… on POST /rules. Otherwise master cannot administratively create rules on behalf of a bayi as documented.
server.py is now 5460+ lines — high priority to split into routers (engines.py, settings.py, rules.py, plan_matrix.py).

Consider WHERE clause in plan-features cache invalidation — currently frontend PlanConfig invalidates 'plan-features' query on save, but bayi panels won't refresh until React Query staleTime expires (~30s per code comment).
PLAN_FEATURES_DEFAULT keys use bool vs int; sanitizer in admin_plan_matrix_set correctly rejects unknown keys and coerces types.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup engine dedupe was the root cause of the multi-tenancy regression — this class of bug would recur on future restarts unless the fix is preserved.
_tenant_scope conflates 'who is calling' (auth) with 'which tenant to operate on' (target). Separate two concerns to allow master admin ops on behalf of bayis.
PolicySettings.update via POST /settings/update accepts full Pydantic payload; consider PATCH semantics with sparse fields so bayi can't clobber master defaults by omission.

Frontend PlanConfig.js only uses gws.master_license / gws.event_license from localStorage; a hard reload without master cookie will bounce to 403. Consider showing a friendly 'yalnızca master erişebilir' page instead of a bare toast.

adminPlanMatrixSave sends {matrix: partial}, backend merges with defaults but frontend already holds full matrix — safe today but could drift; make backend authoritative reply the source of truth after save (already does via r.json().matrix).
seed_data_creation: Test bayi rule injected via pymongo direct (WS-TESTBAYI99999999999999) and cleaned up in teardown of same class. Master settings unchanged (bayi restored to master defaults post-test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: V31 green. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_v31_multitenancy_planmatrix.py covers engines/settings/rules isolation + plan matrix editor CRUD + reset + non-master 403 + regression. CRITICAL: the on_event('startup') dedupe fix in server.py must be preserved — without it, every backend restart wipes bayi engines and re-installs the wrong index. The 'master creating rule on behalf of bayi' test uses direct pymongo insert as a workaround because _tenant_scope precedence is buggy (see backend_issues.minor). Run without xdist parallelism if adding new tests that write to shared collections: `pytest ... -o addopts=`.
rca of the issue: Multi-tenant engines regression root cause: @app.on_event('startup') at server.py:445 ran a legacy dedupe pass that (a) collapsed all engine rows into 6 by name only, deleting every bayi's private copy on backend restart, and (b) recreated the legacy `name_1` single-field unique index. This defeated the multi-tenant fix_engines_index.py migration and caused BulkWriteError E11000 on the next bayi bootstrap. Fix: rewrote startup dedupe to use composite (name, owner_license_key) key, drop legacy name_1, tag legacy untagged docs with owner_license_key='', and recreate the correct composite unique index.
